theme: An open calendar, and a short stack of trip logistics that have waited long enough.
greeting: A clear day, Dan - no meetings, and the girls home with you in St. Pete. The only thing on the horizon is tomorrow's noon call with Valoris; everything else is Croatia trip logistics that have been piling up.

needsAttention.title: Prep for the Valoris call
needsAttention.detail: Martin's call is tomorrow at noon ET. Come with a view on continuing 'as a group' after your talks with Mike and Davit.

needsAttention.title: Book the Cavtat night for Sept 19
needsAttention.detail: The last night of the Croatia trip, near the Dubrovnik airport - and it has to be booked from dry land before you sail on the 8th.

needsAttention.title: Get the Croatia checked bags in writing
needsAttention.detail: The issued ticket shows zero checked bags. Confirm the allowance on Eurowings Discover's own site now, not at the counter.

needsAttention.title: Book the St Pete landing-gap nights
needsAttention.detail: Sept 20-21, between landing at TPA and the Tuesday kid pickup, before the drive to the Orlando villa.

flagged.title: CGI Global's invitation to KL
flagged.detail: Kerrie Waring asks if you'd like to come along to meet a new corporate audience; she leaves for Tokyo Sept 26.

flagged.title: Nautilus sailing balance due
flagged.detail: The $6,475 final payment for the sailing course, due before the September trip.

flagged.title: Home policy renewal notice
flagged.detail: Liberty Mutual homeowner's renewal landed - worth a look before it renews on its own.

inbox.noise: Newsletters, a shipping notice, the Enterprise rental agreement, and a couple of trip confirmations.
inbox.clear: Nothing else is waiting on your reply.

resolved.title: The Valoris call is on the calendar
resolved.detail: Martin sent the invite for Thursday noon ET and you confirmed - nothing more to arrange.

resolved.title: Japan board introduction handled
resolved.detail: You replied to the JOMON team; scheduling the meeting now sits with Furuta-san's office.

resolved.title: Dubrovnik Old Port stay confirmed
resolved.detail: The Airbnb for Sept 9-12 came through - the front end of the trip is set.

recipe.title: Sautéed zucchini with scallions & fresh mozzarella
recipe.why: High summer means the zucchini is at its peak — a quick sauté that lets the season speak for itself.

tasks.title: Assemble the passport packet for the four girls

acts.line: The calendar opened empty - no meetings to answer to.
A rare uninterrupted stretch, good for the things that need real focus.
A full house with the girls here, and one call waiting at noon tomorrow.
